svg.title: Kern Fig. 14.7 — commercial evaporation coefficients for water
svg.text: Kern Fig. 14.7 — commercial evaporation coefficients for water
percentage of the base UD against Δt; solid = untreated, dashed = treated feed (digitized from the slide chart)
Mark Δt = 300 − 226 = 74°F on the Δt axis.
Go up to the untreated (solid) 200° curve (82.5%) and on to the 300° curve (91%).
Interpolate between them for a 226°F vapor: 82.5 + 0.26(91 − 82.5) ≈ 85% (violet dashed line).
Kern reads 86.5% of base at 226°F (used in the solution); 85–86.5% is within chart accuracy.
Redrawn from the slide chart; in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
